_provenance: Read from the game. Nothing here is inferred from the scrape -- if a real value is not known, the scraped one stays, because a plausible guess is worse than a visible mismatch.
_why: The scrape produced wrong cooldowns for both Kayn forms. The forms are MOSTLY identical -- Q and the ultimate match -- but Shadow Assassin genuinely has a shorter Blade's Reach and a much shorter Shadow Step, which is the form's whole identity as the mobile one. An earlier pass here assumed all three states shared every cooldown; they do not.

Kayn._source: Owner-supplied in-game values, 2026-07-29, re-checked per form. Shadow Assassin (blue) has a shorter Blade's Reach and Shadow Step than Rhaast.
